objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with fever, chills, headache, right-sided chest pain, and a productive cough following an abdominal surgery.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Three days after my open cholecystectomy, I developed fever and chills along with a headache. I’ve also had a productive cough for the last 12 hours and a right-sided chest pain that gets worse when I take a deep breath.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in one or both of your legs (for example, around the ankles or calves) recently?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any swelling in my legs around my ankles or calves. I’ve mainly been dealing with the fever and chills, my productive cough, and the right-sided chest pain when I breathe in.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling full much sooner than usual when you eat—like you can’t finish a normal meal because you feel satisfied quickly?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed feeling full sooner than usual or having trouble finishing a normal meal. My main issues are the fever and chills, the productive cough, and the right-sided chest pain that worsens with deep breaths.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have **thick, yellow or green mucus (sputum)** when you cough—rather than clear or watery mucus?
turns.patient_answer: “Yes, when I cough the mucus is thick and it looks yellowish, not clear or watery. I’ve been bringing it up with the cough for the last 12 hours.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you notice that the person is limping or putting less weight on one leg?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I’m not limping and I’m not putting less weight on either leg—I can walk normally. It’s mainly the fever and chills, the thick yellowish productive cough, and the sharp right-sided chest pain when I take a deep breath.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any difficulty moving one of your shoulders—like trouble lifting your arm, reaching overhead, or turning the shoulder as far as usual? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any trouble moving either shoulder, like lifting my arm or reaching overhead—I can move my shoulders normally. The main problem I’m dealing with is the fever and chills, the thick yellowish productive cough, and the sharp right-sided chest pain when I take a deep breath.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever used drugs by injecting them into a vein (for example, with a needle)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I’ve never used any drugs by injecting them into a vein, and I’ve never used needles that way. The only issues I’m dealing with are the fever and chills, the thick yellowish productive cough, and the right-sided chest pain that gets worse when I breathe in.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you currently have shoulder pain (yes or no)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have any shoulder pain. The discomfort I’ve been having is mainly the fever and chills, the thick yellowish productive cough, and the sharp right-sided chest pain that gets worse when I take a deep breath.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you currently smoke cigarettes or use any tobacco products (yes or no)?
turns.patient_answer: “Yes, I’ve been a daily cigarette smoker for about 17 years—around one pack per day. I’m still smoking currently, unless I’m told not to.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you currently have pain in your wrist? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have pain in my wrist. My main symptoms are still the fever and chills, the thick yellowish productive cough, and the sharp right-sided chest pain that worsens with deep breaths.”
